page.layout: One page of text; a decorative woodcut headpiece at top; a dedication title in capitals above a block of text; a decorative woodcut initial at the start of the first paragraph; page number at top right corner. No margin notes.

main_text.l: VM te crebra vti viderem con-
ille te amat. Intellexi enim quod ipsi carus s-
is, & ob familiae tuae praestantiam, & co-
lectione tibi comparasti. Et quod caetera
vincit ob virtutem tuam ac fidem singu-
larem ipsi in itinere ex Germania
hucusque satis probatam. Certe vt cognatio-
nem quandam inter nos natura ipsa con-
stituit, ita tamen facilius rapimur in amo-
rem illorum qui amantur ab aliis, quique

page.notes: The woodcut initial "V" is joined to "VM" as "VM" with the decorative capital; the first word reads "VM" (Cum). Page number 175 is printed at the top right. Some letters in the body are damaged by the woodcut initial and by print wear; "ille" and "amat" are as legible on the scan. Words such as "fidem" and "Hucusque" are read with some uncertainty ("hucusque" printed as "hucque" with a broken letter, marked as read).
